_note: Settings > Connectors > Known servers (E132, projects/everyday/runs/e132). Official remote MCP servers on the maker's own domain. Each was probed on 2026-11-24: the open ones answered an MCP initialize; the sign-in ones gave a 401 whose sign-in this dash's _mcp_discover reads and whose registration took a 127.0.0.1 callback. Left out, with the reason: Figma (refuses outside apps, 403), Slack, GitHub, Asana and Box (an app registered by hand; no self-registration). Add by address still takes any other.
